body.x: Incheon IT Promotion Agency(IITPA, Director Sung-kap Cho, www.iitpa.or.kr) held a 'Prior business council for CES 2012 exhibitors' to promote entering the American market of promising exporters located in Incheon area on Dec. 23th at IITPA conference room.
(Picture: Prior business council for CES 2012 exhibitors)

'CES 2012(Consumer Electronics Show 2012) is the world's largest Consumer Electronics Show held at Las Vegas, America, from Jan. 10 to 13. IITPA will participate in CES 2012 by supporting entry fee for 8 exhibitors, on-the-spot market research, finding buyers, promotion&marketing and others.
IITPA shared information and know-how with representatives or persons in charge of 8 exhibitors at this meeting.

The 8 companies that will participate in CES 2012 are VIVA KOREA(CCTV camera, DVR), Sechang Instrument(web personalization platform based on cloud), YUJIN System(security equipment), Huria(Bone Conduction headphone), PPYPLE(smart phone accessories like smart phone, handsfree holder and others), Chois Technology (PC control devices for presentation), Innoworks(plastic case, screen protector), Mini Robot(dans performance robot, robot-applied game machine).
Incheon IT Promotion Agency is preparing exhaustively from departure to on-the-site marketing in Las vegas for real fruits of companies.
